nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the owned constructor and mutated by transferOwnership.
Public token name string written by the TokenERC20 constructor.
Public token symbol string written by the TokenERC20 constructor.
Token decimals, fixed at 8, used when computing the initial totalSupply.
Total token supply; set in constructor and decremented in burn and burnFrom.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by _transfer, burn and burnFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and burnFrom.
Constructor of owned that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable to a new address.
Constructor that mints totalSupply to msg.sender and sets name and symbol.
Internal balance-moving routine with zero-address and overflow requires and a final assert.
Public entry point that transfers from msg.sender via _transfer.
Public function that spends allowance[_from][msg.sender] then calls _transfer.
Public function that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
Public function that approves a spender then performs an external receiveApproval call on that spender contract.
Public function burning the caller's own tokens and reducing totalSupply.
Public function burning tokens of _from using the caller's allowance.
Payable constructor forwarding initialSupply, tokenName and tokenSymbol to the TokenERC20 constructor.
Overriding public transfer that delegates to the derived _transfer.
Internal transfer with zero-address and overflow requires, no assert, emits Transfer and mylog.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance checks.
External call to the user-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Arithmetic subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value inside TokenERC20._transfer.
Arithmetic subtraction totalSupply -= _value inside burn.
Privileged write owner = newOwner performed in transferOwnership.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the new owner address.
Parameter of the TokenERC20 constructor with the raw supply amount.
Parameter of the TokenERC20 constructor holding the token name.
Parameter of the TokenERC20 constructor holding the token symbol.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial owner in the owned constructor.

newOwner parameter flows into the ownership update.

Function body performs the privileged owner = newOwner write.
initialSupply parameter is used to compute totalSupply.
tokenName parameter is assigned to name.
tokenSymbol parameter is assigned to symbol.
totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) computed in the constructor.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Initial mint is credited to the caller-controlled msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter only consumed by transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
initialSupply parameter only feeds the TokenERC20 constructor supply computation.
tokenName parameter only feeds the TokenERC20 constructor name assignment.
tokenSymbol parameter only feeds the TokenERC20 constructor symbol assignment.
_from parameter is only meaningful as the debited account inside the _transfer routine.
_to parameter is only meaningful as the credited account inside the _transfer routine.
_value parameter is the transferred amount consumed by the _transfer routine.
previousBalances is a short-lived local snapshot used only by the assert in _transfer.
_spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
_extraData parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
initialSupply parameter of the YUNCoinTokens constructor is only forwarded to the base constructor.
